steps.action: On existing F-host only run docs/chatgpt_status/topography/shards/height_difference_2/automation/030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1; preserve/start exactly one persistent canonical daemon and never start a second runner.
Verify all four canonical receipts, persistent_daemon_count_after=1, fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim before business promotion.

Use the live EA OGC Features service. For National LIDAR query real tilename TQ3595, TQ5090 and TQ2570 using advertised filtering/CQL2 support; retain actual dtm_fn, flight dates, surveys, resolution, year, supplied and latest values only.

For Time Stamped DTM use exact native BNG point/polygon intersection. Prefer ArcGIS geometry=x,y geometryType=esriGeometryPoint inSR=27700 intersects; OGC bbox is allowed only with advertised EPSG:27700 CRS handling. Record actual lidar_name/dtm_name/ostilename/flight dates/resolution/transform/geoid/latest; never infer them from a generic sample row.

Fetch EA DTM1m WCS GetCapabilities using an XML-capable client, record the real CoverageId, then DescribeCoverage before GetCoverage. Sample raw pixels inside native HMLR EPSG:27700 polygons, exclude -3.4028235e+38 NoData, and compute parcel statistics only from observed official raster values.

Call current OS Downloads API productId Terrain50 with area=TQ and grid format; require real JSON/download bytes and actual TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 members. Read Metadata_<tile>.xml and require EPSG:27700, vertical EPSG:5701/ODN plus flying-date/lineage fields before sampling documented pixel centres.

Run three EA/OS numeric crosschecks, keep Terrain50 secondary only, then verify port 8012 HTTP readback. Mark manual action RESOLVED only after recovery receipts plus fresh heartbeat/claim are remotely verified.
